finite_rivals.program:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell< a b) (or (< (first a) (first b)) (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) 5) (= (obj-size o) 3))) (objects-8 g 0))])
      (let* ((cells (sort (obj-cells obj) cell<))
             (norm (sort (normalize-cells cells) cell<)))
        (if (or (equal? norm (list (list 0 0) (list 1 1) (list 2 2)))
                (equal? norm (list (list 0 2) (list 1 1) (list 2 0))))
            (paint-cells out (list (second cells)) 4)
            out)))))

finite_rivals.name: setting:{"ink_rule":"target_parity"}
finite_rivals.program:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell< a b) (or (< (first a) (first b)) (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (define main-shape (list (list 0 0) (list 1 1) (list 2 2)))
    (define anti-shape (list (list 0 2) (list 1 1) (list 2 0)))
    (define (norm obj) (sort (normalize-cells (obj-cells obj)) cell<))
    (define (diagonal? obj) (or (equal? (norm obj) main-shape) (equal? (norm obj) anti-shape)))
    (define objects (objects-8 g 0))
    (define gray-objects (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 5)) objects))
    (define targets (filter (lambda (obj) (and (= (obj-color obj) 5) (diagonal? obj))) objects))
    (define ink (if (odd? (length targets)) 2 4))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj targets])
      (paint-cells out (list (second (sort (obj-cells obj) cell<))) ink))))
